reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 discusses multi-component high-entropy alloy barriers for Cu-Si interdiffusion, not Cr-Zr or Al-doped Cr. E2 and E3 describe AlNbTiZr medium-entropy alloy coatings on Zr alloy, focusing on corrosion resistance and oxygen barrier properties, not Cr-Zr interdiffusion or Cr-based coatings. None of the cited passages provide evidence for the specific mechanism, performance, or conditions proposed.
premises: Dilute Al doping (~5 at.%) in Cr coating forms a composite Al2O3-Cr2O3 oxide scale
This composite oxide scale acts as an effective diffusion barrier against Cr-Zr interdiffusion
The barrier reduces interdiffusion by 30-50% relative to pure Cr coatings
The mechanism involves lattice distortion and modified oxidation kinetics from Al addition
The effect holds under both subcritical water (300°C) and high-temperature steam (~1100°C)
